### coesite\_i\_ii\_cernok\_2014\_table1\_pv

- **Description:** Nine measured coesite-I/II observations incorporated as literature data in the Bykova et al. (2018) combined coesite-I/II/III BM3 fit. The fitted ambient row printed in the source table is intentionally excluded as non-independent EOS output.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Cernok; Bykova; Boffa Ballaran; Liermann; Hanfland; Dubrovinsky
    - **Year:** 2014
    - **Title:** High-pressure crystal chemistry of coesite-I and its transition to coesite-II
    - **Source:** Zeitschrift fur Kristallographie - Crystalline Materials
    - **Volume:** 229
    - **Locator:** 761-773
    - **DOI:** 10.1515/zkri-2014-1763
- **Source location:** Article Table 1; author thesis Table 5.1, page 72
- **Associated EOS records:** coesite\_i\_iii\_bykova\_2018\_300k\_bm3
- **Notes:** The source cells contain Z=16 for coesite-I and Z=32 for coesite-II. Per-formula-unit volumes and their standard deviations are exact divisions by Z.

[Observation resource](https://github.com/CPrescher/peritheos/blob/main/peritheos/data/datasets/coesite-i-ii-cernok-2014-table1-pv.csv)
— SHA-256 `733b94709bd150635b1fe5e7975a652055cc745e604dad723f2b06146b3ce575`.

### coesite\_ii\_iii\_bykova\_2018\_table2\_pv

- **Description:** All 15 coesite-II and coesite-III unit-cell observations in Bykova et al. (2018) Supplementary Table 2, including distinct repeat measurements and the two high-pressure coesite-III states coexisting with coesite-IV.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Bykova; Bykov; Cernok; Tidholm; Simak; Hellman; Belov; Abrikosov; Liermann; Hanfland; Prakapenka; Prescher; Dubrovinskaia; Dubrovinsky
    - **Year:** 2018
    - **Title:** Metastable silica high pressure polymorphs as structural proxies of deep Earth silicate melts
    - **Source:** Nature Communications
    - **Volume:** 9
    - **Locator:** 4789
    - **DOI:** 10.1038/s41467-018-07265-z
- **Source location:** Supplementary Table 2
- **Associated EOS records:** coesite\_i\_iii\_bykova\_2018\_300k\_bm3
- **Notes:** The source cells contain Z=32 for coesite-II and Z=24 for coesite-III. The source's V/Z column is retained directly. Repeated pressures are distinct measurements identified in Supplementary Table 1 by attenuation or DAC orientation.
